name: FilterTube
subtitle: Calmer, safer video on iPhone and iPad

apps.name: FilterTube (Direct)
apps.subtitle: Filters, profiles and offline saving
apps.localizedDescription: FilterTube helps you decide what shows up in your feed. Hide channels and words you don't want, set up profiles for the family, and save videos to watch offline. Free, no ads, no sign-up.

versions.localizedDescription: Uljhan peeking is the new app icon (Kriti waving stays in Settings), and FilterTube is a much smaller download: about 91 MB instead of 118 MB, so SideStore installs and updates finish faster.

Parent updates reach a child's device within seconds with a banner, a Study timetable that switches what you see by time of day, 415 study packs for 81 countries, a new day bar, a home-screen widget and calendar export.
Backups and sync keep every profile and setting, Kids profiles keep optional services off, the HD decoder is on by default, and fixes from the 3.6.3 extension engine.
First iPhone and iPad release. Filters, profiles and offline saving.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: FilterTube uses the camera only to scan Nanah pairing QR codes for private device-to-device sync.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: FilterTube finds your other FilterTube devices on this Wi-Fi so you can pair and send playlists, notes and rules without the internet. Nothing is trusted until you match the safety phrase on both screens.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FilterTube uses the microphone only when you tap Voice input in Search, to turn your speech into search text you can review.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FilterTube reads videos you allow so they can appear in your separate local device library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FilterTube turns your spoken search into text in the search field. Nothing is searched until you submit it.
